config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-03: FHIRPath — §5.1 Existence. Test these items: empty(); exists([criteria]); all(criteria); allTrue(); anyTrue(); allFalse(); anyFalse(); subsetOf(other); supersetOf(other); count(); distinct(); isDistinct(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
